description: The shared libraries an ELF file of the Linux AppImage may need without the image carrying them: the recipient's own. Everything else a bundled ELF file needs must be in the image. tools/build/check-elf-needed-closure.cjs reads this file; a library added here needs a reason a reviewer can check, because the image then stops being self-contained for it.

baseline.musl: unsupported: a musl system (Alpine) cannot run glibc programs; the AppImage's AppRun preflight refuses it in the user's language (startup.linux_appimage_musl_body).

groups.reason: One glibc installation, loader included. It cannot be bundled piecemeal: the loader, libc and the recipient's GTK, GL and NSS modules must agree. The image is built on the oldest supported LTS instead, and check-elf-glibc-ceiling.cjs refuses a newer symbol version.
The recipient's GTK stack links its own GLib and C++ runtime; a bundled older copy shadows them and the tray fails to load (see stage-linux-network-runtime.py recipient_base).
The tray library and the webview windows load the recipient's GTK 3 into the daemon's process; the image bundles only the tray's own libraries without GTK.
